# EngMan

> EngMan is an iPhone app with 200 coaching cards for engineering managers: questions, prompts and frameworks for 1:1s, refinement, retros and stakeholder conversations.

Available now on the App Store.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 18.5 or later
- Price: free with four decks; the other six decks unlock with an annual subscription (£3.99 a year) or lifetime access (£14.99 one-off)
- Privacy: decks, favourites and your own cards live on the device and sync through the user's own iCloud; no account needed
- Content: ten decks, 200 cards
- Developer: Mat Benfield (thechelsuk), made in the UK

## Links

- [EngMan website](https://engman.thechels.uk/): the official marketing site
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/engman-em-coaching-cards/id6747295473): download the app
- [Privacy policy](https://thechels.uk/app/privacy): what the app does and does not collect
- [Project page](https://thechels.uk/projects/engman): background from the developer

## Features

- 200 coaching cards across ten decks
- Swipe right to save favourites, left to dismiss
- Favourites sync with iCloud
- Write your own cards in a My Cards deck
- Share a card as an image
- Works offline

## FAQ

### What is EngMan?

EngMan is a deck of 200 coaching cards for engineering managers: questions, prompts and frameworks for 1:1s, refinement, wellbeing, coaching, team building, performance, strategy and leadership.

### Is EngMan free?

Yes. Download it free and use the 1:1 Questions, Refinement, Wellbeing and Quotes decks. The other six decks unlock with an annual subscription at £3.99 a year, or lifetime access for £14.99.

### Does it work offline?

Yes. All the decks live on your phone, so it works with no signal. No account is needed.

### Can I add my own questions?

Yes. Write your own prompts in the My Cards deck, alongside the built-in decks.

### Which devices are supported?

iPhone running iOS 18.5 or later.
